verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.randomlabs.ai/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured markdown index of the docs. Every docs page cited is also served as raw .md (for example /en/getting-started/introduction.md), which gives an agent directly consumable, agent-oriented documentation. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or single-file full-content bundle, no first-party documentation promoting or describing the llms.txt, and no independent or community corroboration of agents using it.
